recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-46968 unless the work group reopens the later DeviceAssociation subject/focus model; future wording review should proceed through later feedback rather than restoring operation/operator prose.
issue_request: FHIR-46968 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 OO change request asking to clarify when DeviceAssociation.operation.operator should be used versus DeviceAssociation.subject, especially when the subject is a Practitioner or RelatedPerson. The resolution clarified that relationship reflects the overall device-subject relationship while operation reflects shorter-term use and identifies the operator; absence of operator must not imply subject is operator when periods of use matter.
initial_application: Upstream commit baaf631812b2b2d23fae4d49ffb0071e51a27b85, merged through HL7/fhir#3532, added the requested comment to DeviceAssociation.subject and DeviceAssociation.operation.operator. That was a real application, but it targeted the operation/operator backbone that no longer exists in current R6 source.
additional_context: DeviceAssociation is active in source/fhir.ini. Later applied FHIR-47604 removed the DeviceAssociation.operation/operator backbone, added DeviceAssociation.focus, and moved operator relationship semantics into DeviceAssociation.relationship, base period, associationStatus, subject, and focus. The current introduction states the operation backbone was collapsed, and current subject/focus definitions describe how operator relationships are represented. Combined-branch commit 692324e7b3376004c65de20d5ab4781136fdea15 already removed stale operation wording from DeviceAssociation.subject during FHIR-47604 reconciliation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing the FHIR-46968 operation.operator text would be incorrect because DeviceAssociation.operation.operator is absent from current source; the remaining authoritative source already reflects the later subject/focus model.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied/Persuasive with Modification issue removed DeviceAssociation.operation/operator, added focus, and made the original operation.operator clarification obsolete. It is already represented on the combined branch.
Later reconciliation aligned DeviceAssociation.subject definition and references while preserving the current subject/focus operator guidance; it is already represented on the combined branch.
Unresolved later feedback about DeviceAssociation subject wording may inform future review, but it is not a final applied/published decision and was not decided here.
